questions.q: Which tag's text shows in the browser tab?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket se teks wys in die blaaieroortjie?
questions.explain: The <title> sits in the <head>; it is not displayed on the page but shows in the titlebar or browser tab.
questions.explainAf: Die <title> sit in die <head>; dit word nie op die bladsy vertoon nie, maar wys in die titelbalk of blaaieroortjie.

questions.q: Which code shows an image correctly?
questions.qAf: Watter kode wys 'n prent korrek?
questions.explain: needs src (the path to the file) and alt (the alternative text).
questions.explainAf: het src (die pad na die lêer) en alt (die alternatiewe teks) nodig.

questions.q: What does CSS stand for?
questions.qAf: Waarvoor staan CSS?
questions.explain: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is a styling language that separates the design from the HTML content.
questions.explainAf: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is 'n stileringstaal wat die ontwerp van die HTML-inhoud skei.

questions.q: What colour is rgb(0, 0, 255)?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is rgb(0, 0, 255)?
questions.explain: rgb(R, G, B): no red, no green and full blue (255).
questions.explainAf: rgb(R, G, B): geen rooi, geen groen en volle blou (255).

questions.q: What does Wrap Text do in Excel?
questions.qAf: Wat doen Wrap Text in Excel?
options: Shows all the text of a cell on several lines
Turns the text at an angle
optionsAf: Wys al die teks van 'n sel op verskeie reëls
questions.explain: Wrap Text shows all the text on multiple lines. Merge and Center joins cells, and Orientation turns the text at an angle.
questions.explainAf: Wrap Text wys al die teks op verskeie reëls. Merge and Center voeg selle saam, en Orientation draai die teks skuins.

questions.q: Cells A1 to A4 hold: 6, 10, (empty), 8. What does =AVERAGE(A1:A4) give?
questions.qAf: Selle A1 tot A4 bevat: 6, 10, (leeg), 8. Wat gee =AVERAGE(A1:A4)?
questions.explain: AVERAGE ignores blanks: (6 + 10 + 8) ÷ 3 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE ignoreer leë selle: (6 + 10 + 8) ÷ 3 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

questions.q: A car dashboard shows the speed and fuel, but not every wire in the engine. Which pillar of computational thinking is this?
questions.qAf: 'n Motor se paneelbord wys die spoed en brandstof, maar nie elke draad in die enjin nie. Watter pilaar van berekeningsdenke is dit?
questions.explain: Abstraction hides unnecessary detail to focus on what matters.
questions.explainAf: Abstraksie versteek onnodige besonderhede om op die belangrike te fokus.

questions.q: Which of these is an object type in Java?
questions.qAf: Watter een van hierdie is 'n objektipe in Java?
questions.explain: Object types start with an uppercase letter (String, Gogga); primitive types start with a lowercase letter.
questions.explainAf: Objektipes begin met 'n hoofletter (String, Gogga); primitiewe tipes begin met 'n kleinletter.

questions.q: What does a constraint do in a FreeCAD sketch?
questions.qAf: Wat doen 'n beperking in 'n FreeCAD-skets?
options: It removes a degree of freedom and fixes a size, position or angle
It turns the sketch into a 3D part
optionsAf: Dit verwyder 'n vryheidsgraad en maak 'n grootte, posisie of hoek vas
questions.explain: A constraint is a rule that removes a DOF. A fillet rounds a corner, and Pad makes the 3D part.
questions.explainAf: 'n Beperking is 'n reël wat 'n DOF verwyder. 'n Fillet rond 'n hoek af, en Pad maak die 3D-onderdeel.

questions.q: An Arduino pin gives 5 V and the LED drops 2 V. The current must be 25 mA (0.025 A). Which resistor is needed?
questions.qAf: 'n Arduino-pen gee 5 V en die LED se spanningsval is 2 V. Die stroom moet 25 mA (0,025 A) wees. Watter resistor is nodig?
questions.explain: The resistor takes 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0.025 = 120 Ω.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor neem 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0,025 = 120 Ω.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Most HTML tags come in pairs: an opening tag and a closing tag.
questions.qAf: Die meeste HTML-etikette kom in pare: 'n openingsetiket en 'n sluitetiket.
questions.explain:
For example

and

. Self-closing tags such as
are the exception.
questions.explainAf:
Byvoorbeeld

en

. Selfsluitende etikette soos
is die uitsondering.

questions.q: A comment written as <!-- comment --> is displayed on the web page.
questions.qAf: 'n Kommentaar wat as <!-- comment --> geskryf is, word op die webblad vertoon.
questions.explain: HTML comments are not displayed; they are notes in the code.
questions.explainAf: HTML-kommentaar word nie vertoon nie; dit is notas in die kode.

questions.q: Rows in a spreadsheet are horizontal and labelled with numbers.
questions.qAf: Rye in 'n sigblad is horisontaal en word met getalle benoem.
questions.explain: Columns are vertical and labelled with letters.
questions.explainAf: Kolomme is vertikaal en word met letters benoem.

questions.q: In Java, // starts a comment.
questions.qAf: In Java begin // 'n kommentaar.
questions.explain: // starts a single-line comment; statements end with ;.
questions.explainAf: // begin 'n eenreël-kommentaar; stellings eindig met ;.

questions.q: Pad turns a 3D part back into a flat sketch.
questions.qAf: Pad maak van 'n 3D-onderdeel weer 'n plat skets.
questions.explain: Pad does the opposite: it turns a flat sketch into a 3D part with a set thickness.
questions.explainAf: Pad doen die teenoorgestelde: dit maak van 'n plat skets 'n 3D-onderdeel met 'n gestelde dikte.

questions.q: An embedded system can run almost any software.
questions.qAf: 'n Ingebedde stelsel kan byna enige sagteware laat loop.
questions.explain: An embedded system is built for one dedicated job; a general-purpose computer runs almost any software.
questions.explainAf: 'n Ingebedde stelsel is vir een toegewyde taak gebou; 'n rekenaar vir algemene gebruik laat byna enige sagteware loop.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each HTML tag in column A with what it is used for in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke HTML-etiket in kolom A by waarvoor dit gebruik word in kolom B.
questions.explain:
The extra description in column B belongs to
.
questions.explainAf:
Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B behoort aan
.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each Excel data type to a value it would show.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke Excel-datatipe aan 'n waarde wat dit sou wys.
questions.explain: Currency shows R and 2 decimal places, Percentage a % symbol, Text words, and Number a chosen number of decimal places.
questions.explainAf: Currency wys R en 2 desimale plekke, Percentage 'n %-simbool, Text woorde, en Number 'n gekose getal desimale plekke.

questions.q: Match each component in column A with how it works in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke komponent in kolom A by hoe dit werk in kolom B.
pairs: Its resistance changes with the light falling on it
Works like a volume control, with a central wiper
Three LEDs (red, green, blue) that mix colours
Two resistors in series that split the total voltage
pairsAf: Sy weerstand verander met die lig wat daarop val
Werk soos 'n volumebeheer, met 'n sleper in die middel
Drie LED's (rooi, groen, blou) wat kleure meng
Twee resistors in serie wat die totale spanning verdeel
extra: Makes sound when a crystal vibrates
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the piezo buzzer.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die piëzo-zoemer.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps for adding a worksheet and giving it a name in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n werkblad by te voeg en dit 'n naam te gee, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Click the plus (+) icon to add a sheet
Type the new name and press Enter
stepsAf: Klik die plus- (+-)ikoon om 'n blad by te voeg
Regsklik op die nuwe blad se oortjie
Tik die nuwe naam en druk Enter
questions.explain: Add with +, then right-click the tab and Rename (or double-click the tab).
questions.explainAf: Voeg by met +, regsklik dan op die oortjie en kies Rename (of dubbelklik op die oortjie).

questions.q: Put the parts of the Blinky LED circuit in the order the current flows, starting at the Arduino.
questions.qAf: Plaas die dele van die Blinky-LED-stroombaan in die volgorde waarin die stroom vloei, en begin by die Arduino.
questions.explain: The resistor is in series before the LED to limit the current. Current enters at the anode and leaves at the cathode to GND.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor is in serie voor die LED om die stroom te beperk. Die stroom gaan by die anode in en verlaat dit by die katode na GND.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Neo makes a page about his hobbies:
questions.scenarioAf: Neo maak 'n bladsy oor sy stokperdjies:
questions.code:
My Hobbies

  • Robotics
  • Soccer
Get FreeCAD

questions.q: What do the bullets of the list look like?
questions.qAf: Hoe lyk die kolpunte van die lys?
questions.explain: <ul type="square"> gives square bullets.
questions.explainAf: <ul type="square"> gee vierkantige kolpunte.

questions.q: Where does Neo's Hobbies appear?
questions.qAf: Waar verskyn Neo's Hobbies?
options: As the main heading on the page
optionsAf: As die hoofopskrif op die bladsy
questions.explain: It is in the <title>, which shows in the browser tab. The heading on the page comes from <h1>.
questions.explainAf: Dit is in die <title>, wat in die blaaieroortjie wys. Die opskrif op die bladsy kom van <h1>.

questions.q: Neo wants the FreeCAD link to open in a new tab. What must he add to the <a> tag?
questions.qAf: Neo wil hê die FreeCAD-skakel moet in 'n nuwe oortjie oopmaak. Wat moet hy by die <a>-etiket voeg?
questions.explain: target="_blank" opens the link in a new tab, which keeps visitors on your site.
questions.explainAf: target="_blank" maak die skakel in 'n nuwe oortjie oop, wat besoekers op jou webwerf hou.

questions.q: The indentation in Neo's code changes how the page looks in the browser.
questions.qAf: Die inkeping in Neo se kode verander hoe die bladsy in die blaaier lyk.
questions.explain: Indentation makes the code readable and shows where tags open and close; it does not change the page.
questions.explainAf: Inkeping maak die kode leesbaar en wys waar etikette oop- en toemaak; dit verander nie die bladsy nie.

questions.scenario: Neo also writes this Java code:

questions.q: What is the value of score after the third line?
questions.qAf: Wat is die waarde van score ná die derde reël?
questions.explain: score = score + 5 takes the old value (12), adds 5 and stores 17.
questions.explainAf: score = score + 5 neem die ou waarde (12), tel 5 by en stoor 17.

questions.q: What does the last line print?
questions.qAf: Wat druk die laaste reël?
questions.explain: Concatenation (+) joins the text and the values: Neo has 17.
questions.explainAf: Aaneenskakeling (+) voeg die teks en die waardes saam: Neo has 17.

questions.q: Why is player declared as a String?
questions.qAf: Hoekom word player as 'n String gedeklareer?
options: It stores text, written in double quotes
optionsAf: Dit stoor teks, tussen dubbele aanhalingstekens
questions.explain: String stores text in double quotes, e.g. "Neo".
questions.explainAf: String stoor teks tussen dubbele aanhalingstekens, bv. "Neo".

questions.q: score++ would add 1 to score.
questions.qAf: score++ sal 1 by score tel.
questions.explain: ++ is shorthand for score = score + 1, just like counter++ in a loop.
questions.explainAf: ++ is die kort vorm van score = score + 1, net soos counter++ in 'n lus.

questions.scenario: Kagiso uses a potentiometer to dim an LED in TinkerCAD.
questions.scenarioAf: Kagiso gebruik 'n potensiometer om 'n LED in TinkerCAD dof te maak.

questions.q: Where must the wiper (middle pin) of the potentiometer be connected?
questions.qAf: Waar moet die sleper (middelste pen) van die potensiometer gekoppel word?
questions.explain: One side goes to 5 V, the other to ground, and the wiper to an analog input pin.
questions.explainAf: Een kant gaan na 5 V, die ander na grond, en die sleper na 'n analoë insetpen.

questions.q: The reading is 400. Which value should be sent to the LED after mapping?
questions.qAf: Die lesing is 400. Watter waarde moet ná die afbeelding (mapping) na die LED gestuur word?
questions.explain: Map 0–1023 to 0–255 by dividing by 4: 400 ÷ 4 = 100.
questions.explainAf: Beeld 0–1023 op 0–255 af deur met 4 te deel: 400 ÷ 4 = 100.

questions.q: How many colours can an RGB LED mix?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel kleure kan 'n RGB-LED meng?
questions.explain: Each of the three LEDs has 256 brightness levels: 256 × 256 × 256 colours.
questions.explainAf: Elk van die drie LED's het 256 helderheidsvlakke: 256 × 256 × 256 kleure.

questions.q: What is a voltage divider?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n spanningsdeler?
options: Two resistors in series that split the total voltage
optionsAf: Twee resistors in serie wat die totale spanning verdeel
questions.explain: The voltage across each resistor is proportional to its resistance; it makes variable voltage inputs for the Arduino.
questions.explainAf: Die spanning oor elke resistor is eweredig aan sy weerstand; dit maak veranderlike spanningsinsette vir die Arduino.
